mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (member_id, title, content, emotion) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{emotion})
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.member_id, b.title, b.content, b.emotion, b.created_at, b.updated_at, b.is_deleted, m.nickname FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, emotion = #{emotion}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.member_id, b.title, b.content, b.emotion, b.created_at, b.updated_at, b.is_deleted, m.nickname FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.id WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
